title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 16. Notes with grave concern the enduring, severe humanitarian situation in Gaza, including widespread food insecurity and famine; notes with serious concern the persistent obstacles to humanitarian access and the alarm expressed by the VP/HR regarding recent licensing decisions constraining humanitarian organisations that operate in Gaza; calls on all parties to enable the rapid delivery of humanitarian aid; underlines that measures that unduly restrict humanitarian actors risk dismantling essential humanitarian assistance at a time of acute need; is concerned about compliance with international law and the relevant UN resolutions by the Israeli Government and the terrorist organisation Hamas, and the persistence of cycles of violence and terrorist attacks across the Middle East; recalls the obligation of all parties to comply with international law and the relevant UN resolutions, including the protection of civilians, humanitarian personnel and journalists;
